name: Trollskull Manor (Pre-1492 DR)
description: A four-story historic property in the North Ward of Waterdeep, characterized by sagging rooftops, crumbling balconies, and a faded sign of a grinning skull with spectral blue trolls. It holds a dark, checkered past and sat abandoned as a decrepit money pit before its recent acquisition.
key_facts: The building originally served as an orphanage run by a hag, which was eventually destroyed by the City Watch.
The city auctioned the property to a man named Lif in 1437 DR, who transformed it into a tavern.
Lif died tragically in the cellar when he was crushed by an ale cask, and his spirit remained tethered to the tavern as a poltergeist.
The building suffered a catastrophic interior collapse in 1452 DR, which caused lasting fractures in the western load-bearing wall.
Lif's estate transferred the deed in 1452 DR to the Morley family.
A wizard named Alecto's family acquired partial ownership 50 years prior, but the claim was lost in a bureaucratic paperwork error.
The property sat empty for years—save for a group of halflings who lived there briefly—until Volothamp Geddarm purchased it to research its hauntings.
gm_notes: The haunted and dilapidated nature of the tavern serves as both a massive financial sink and a supernatural mystery for the party. The hidden fey portal and hag's lair in the basement are lingering threats from its days as an orphanage.
